details: For finite concept classes, the stronger bound is $\mathrm{NCTD} \ge \lceil \mathrm{dens}/2 \rceil$.
name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Double Density or Average Degree
proof: For every edge of the $1$-inclusion graph, a non-clashing teacher mapping must use the differing instance in at least one of the two endpoint teaching sets.  Averaging over concepts gives a teaching set of size at least half the average degree.
